flows:
Navigate to https://mlyfo.vercel.app/signup then Type "Split Tester" into the Full name field
Type "splitw4poem@mlyfo.app" into the Email field
Type "splitw4poem" into the Username field
Type "kane-password-123" into the Password field
Click "Create account"

Navigate to https://mlyfo.vercel.app/app/splits then Type "Kane dinner w4poem" into the "What’s it for?" field
Type "236" into the Total field
Type "zoya, kabir, sofia" into the "Who’s paying you back?" field
Assert the page says "4 people, $59.00 each"
Click "Create split and links"
Assert a split called "Kane dinner w4poem" is listed with "1 of 4 paid"
Assert that split shows "$59.00" for zoya, kabir and sofia with a "Copy link" button for each
